input.overview: In Defender, each wave ends after 15 Landers are destroyed. Hit each lit Lander drop target before its Humanoid becomes a Mutant, then hit any moving Mutant Bull's-Eye and finish the remaining Landers to complete the wave. Complete Bomber lanes 1 through 4 to advance Bonus X and light Reverse; at 10x, the Warp Bull's-Eye advances three waves. Hit a Pod target to light Swarmers, clear the lit Swarmer Bull's-Eyes to reopen the return gate, and lock three balls in the right trough to start three-ball Multiball.
input.simpleOverview: Complete a wave by hitting the lit Lander drop targets, then any Mutant Bull's-Eye, until all 15 Landers are gone. Complete Bomber lanes 1 through 4 for Bonus X; at 10x, hit the Warp Bull's-Eye to advance three waves. Lock three balls in the right trough to start Multiball.
input.summary: Protect Humanoids first, because a missed rescue adds a moving Mutant target. Build Bomber lanes toward Warp when safe, and take right-trough locks whenever the feed is controlled.

quickInfo.name: Warp Three Waves
quickInfo.summary: Reach 10x, then hit the Warp Bull's-Eye.

quickInfo.name: Start Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Lock three balls in the right trough.

steps.text: Hit the flashing Lander drop target to rescue its Humanoid; if it becomes a Mutant, follow and hit the moving Mutant Bull's-Eye.
Clear all 15 Landers and any Mutants to complete the current wave.
Complete Bomber lanes 1 through 4 to raise Bonus X; at 10x, knock down the Warp target and hit its Bull's-Eye to advance three waves.
Feed balls into the right lockup trough; the third lock starts three-ball Multiball.

alternatives.title: Smart Bomb rescue
alternatives.when: Use this when several enemies are active or the ball is about to drain.

steps.text: Press the right cabinet Smart Bomb button to clear active Landers, Baiters, and Swarmers.
If all Landers are still present and no Mutants exist, use the bomb to complete the wave immediately.
Shoot the right lockup trough once for each available ball.
Lock the third ball to release all three and begin Multiball.

machineSetup: Check Reverse, Smart Bomb, Extra Ball, Warp, Multiball, Bonus X, and wave-completion settings before play.
Test all Lander and Mutant targets and lamps, Bomber lanes 1-4, Warp target and Bull's-Eye, Pod and Swarmer targets, return gate, lock trough, all three flippers, and both cabinet buttons.

playfieldReferences.label: Lander targets
playfieldReferences.description: Left and right banks used to rescue Humanoids and clear waves.

playfieldReferences.label: Mutant Bull's-Eyes
playfieldReferences.description: Bull's-Eye targets used after a Lander converts a Humanoid.

playfieldReferences.label: Bomber lanes 1-4
playfieldReferences.description: Top lanes that build Bonus X and qualify Reverse and Warp.

playfieldReferences.label: Pod and Swarmer targets
playfieldReferences.description: Targets that create and clear Swarmers and control the return gate.

playfieldReferences.label: Right lockup trough
playfieldReferences.description: Three-position ball lock that starts Multiball.

techniques.name: Post Pass
techniques.instruction: Use a controlled post pass to move the ball to the flipper with the cleaner angle on the lit Lander or the right lock trough.

cautions.issue: Reverse and Smart Bomb are cabinet-button features, not ordinary playfield shots.
cautions.response: Locate both buttons before starting; saving a bomb until the playfield is crowded preserves its value.
